text.p: These were the headlines on Kuku Raadio at noon. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- International experts are helping Estonia to decentralise its central government with the agriculture and culture ministries tagged to move from the capital as well as the regional affairs office.
- Estonia could help Sweden reduce its unemployment according to the Estonian bi-weekly newspaper published in Stockholm citing the problems employers face under Swedish employment laws.
